checkedAlternates.risk: 1/4-inch TS looks nearly identical to 1/4-inch TRS.
checkedAlternates.resolution: TS has only two conductors (Tip-Sleeve) and carries an unbalanced signal (group-4), whereas TRS has three conductors for balanced mono (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Speakon is a locking pro-audio connector like XLR.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Speakon carries high-current amplified speaker loads (group-2), not low-level balanced mic/line signals (group-3).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
